read.en: Marvell rose 2.3% on Oct 26 to $233.78, trading between $223.75 and $238.58. It is below the falling 5-day ($234.2), 10-day ($239.1) and 100-day ($240.6) and the rising 30-day ($253.6) averages, but above the rising 200-day ($180.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($250.77), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 迈威尔 10月26日上涨 2.3%，收于 $233.78，盘中区间 $223.75–238.58。股价位于下行的 5 日（$234.2）、10 日（$239.1）和 100 日均线（$240.6）以及上行的 30 日均线（$253.6）下方，但高于上行的 200 日均线（$180.3）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$250.77），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close cleared the $231.6 Oct 23 high; the $238.6 high stalled below the 10-day. Resistance is $234.2–238.6 (5-day, Oct 26 high), then $239.1–240.6 (10 and 100-day) and $250–250.8 (Oct 21 high, SAR). Support is $223.8–226.5 (Oct 26 low, Oct 16 and 20 lows), then $220.2 (Oct 22 low) and $200.6. A close above $240.6 would target $250; a close below $220 would open $200.6.

s.en: Oct 26 low $223.8; Oct 16 and Oct 20 lows $226.5
